name: Suzu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Suzu city emblem in red: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised hourglass shape.
history: Municipal flag of Suzu, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 September 1954.

features.role: Suzu city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised hourglass shape
